nature_reserves.source: NParks Nature Reserves Gazette, data.gov.sg d_dfd037f5064cb2e2b2e358ceeccb4af7

planning_areas.source: URA Master Plan 2019 subzone boundary (no sea), data.gov.sg d_8594ae9ff96d0c708bc2af633048edfb
planning_areas.note: Subzones dissolved to planning areas; REGION_N gives the five URA regions

trees.source: NParks Trees.sg via github.com/cheeaun/sgtreesdata (community copy, Oct 2021; (c) NParks)
trees.allometry: AGB = 0.0673 (rho D^2 H)^0.976, Chave et al. 2014; girth-class midpoints; relative index only

landcover.source: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200, 10 m, tile N00E102 (CC BY 4.0)
landcover.note: Green = tree, shrub, grass, herbaceous wetland, mangrove; managed = outside gazetted nature reserves

planning_area_estimates.method: equal-weight mix of proxy shares; Dirichlet(1) weight sensitivity
planning_area_estimates.status: proxy allocation, NOT observed regional waste

candidate_sites.source: URA Master Plan 2019 Land Use layer, data.gov.sg d_90d86daa5bfaa371668b84fa5f01424f
candidate_sites.rule: Contiguous BUSINESS 2 clusters (40 m merge); largest per region, then next largest >= 4.0 km apart; islands excluded; top 10
candidate_sites.caveat: Zoning only; not vacant land, not approved sites

facilities.caveat: Names geocoded from OSM; biomass power plants not identified by name in OSM

road_distances.source: OSRM table service on OpenStreetMap roads (router.project-osrm.org; ODbL data)
road_distances.origins: planning-area representative points (inside polygon), not collection depots
road_distances.fallback: straight line x 1.35 for islands or points >2 km from a road
